origin.description: The locale stored in the readr.default_locale option. The default is US English, UTF-8, and UTC.

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: The data, path, or collector this function accepts.

origin.details: The locale stored in the readr.default_locale option. The default is US English, UTF-8, and UTC.
origin.value: The same value readr 2.2.0 returns for this case, written as one line in the output.
origin.example:
loc <- default_locale()
paste(loc$decimal_mark, loc$tz, loc$encoding, sep = ";")

translation.description: The locale stored in the readr.default_locale option. The default is US English, UTF-8, and UTC.

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: The data, path, or collector this function accepts.

translation.details: The locale stored in the readr.default_locale option. The default is US English, UTF-8, and UTC.
translation.value: The same value readr 2.2.0 returns for this case, written as one line in the output.
translation.example:
loc = default_locale()
return loc.decimal_mark + ";" + loc.tz + ";" + loc.encoding
